$Comment: The Christmas Trousers, the leg piece of the Christmas Set (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Set.json), sold at Elsie the Weaver's Christmas stall once Santa counts a player Very Nice. A full item body with no Parent, so it inherits no recipe and nobody crafts it: they wear the game's own cotton trousers (Armor_Cloth_Cotton_Legs' model, texture, icon and armour numbers). Their own stats ride the native Armor block: the cotton trousers' resistances plus 5% less Ice damage, Health and Stamina like any armour, and ReputationGain_Christmas_Nice_List (10 is +10%), which raises every gain of Santa's favor while they are worn. Raise or lower an Amount to tune them; the set adds its own bonus on top.
